text:
tess (PM): Quick review please 1 Deployments & Rollouts UI. Key things: timeline scrubber affordance, canary scheduler presets, A/B variant labels, and safer rollback confirmation copy. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rollouts-ux.

deploy-bot: Staging: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollouts/8510 (build #8510) :eyes:

harry (Design): Timeline should default to a compact summary row to reduce noise. Expand on click. For canary scheduler, propose presets: Quick Ramp, Conservative, Manual. Copy tweak: change CTA to "Start canary rollout".

min (FE): Agree on lazy-loading diffs only on "Show diff" click. Keyboard support for scrubber: arrows 1%, Shift+arrows 5%, Home/End to jump. Announce percent changes with polite aria-live.

zoe (Accessibility): A11y checklist: scrubber hit target >=44px, tick labels contrast >=4.5:1, tooltip triggers must be focusable, modals trap focus and return focus. Provide pattern fills + textual legend for traffic slices.

alejandra (Platform): A/B variants should show short stable ids (e.g., v6  9b2f) and link to experiment metrics. Show both percent and estimated request counts (e.g., "20% ~ 200 req/min").

sam (SRE): Rollback modal copy proposal:
```
Title: Confirm rollback to v6
Body: New requests will route to v6. Ongoing streaming sessions may continue on current instances for up to 3 minutes. To confirm type the tag: v6
Buttons: Cancel | Confirm rollback (destructive)
```
Require full commit hash only for infra-level rollbacks. Add audit export (CSV) with time,user,action,from,to,reason.

harry (Design): I'll upload compact timeline + two modal variants (type-to-confirm and checkbox) to Figma. Add a small inline timeline preview in the modal.

min (FE): I'll open a PR tomorrow with accessibility attributes and keyboard interactions. Will lazy-load diffs and add copy-to-clipboard for hashes (announce via live-region).

zoe (Accessibility): I'll run keyboard-only pass after the PR lands and review focus order.

tess (PM): Thanks all 1 I'll create tickets for: 1) scrubbing accessibility (min/zoe), 2) modal copy + type-to-confirm (harry/min), 3) schedule presets + metrics link (alejandra), 4) audit export (sam). Ping me for pairing on the commit-tag confirmation UX.

harry (Design): LGTM :thumbsup:

min (FE): ack
